status: ADDENDUM 2 to the pre-registered protocol v3 (config/p11_bars_tiers_protocol_v3.json and addendum d1, both unchanged), written and committed BEFORE any fit on this basis. PROPOSAL ONLY; nothing is installed or approved; config/threshold_approvals.json is not touched.
owner_decision: Owner 2026-11-24 (decided directly, relayed by the coordinator): for Standard and New-Format O/U 2.5, the bars must ALSO be re-measured on a new price basis, the "median real price": the median of the real (vigged) prices across all books, minimum 3 two-sided books. It replaces the fixed one-book order. Serving side: PR #104 (draft).

basis.markets: over25 only (cells over25_over and over25_under), both tracks. Every other market keeps the v3 fixed-order prices of the D1 run, row for row.
basis.books: every bookmaker in the private store's BET-role tiers BT (eu) and OUU (uk) with a two-sided pair on the exact 2.5 line; each book's EARLIEST provable bet-time pair (same timing rules as v3: provider kickoff inside the fixture's day window, snapshot strictly before kickoff, 00:00:00-stamped pairs dropped, join integrity re-verified)
basis.price: Over price = median of the books' Over prices; Under price = median of the books' Under prices (real, vigged prices; the study de-vigs the resulting pair exactly as it de-vigs any pair)
basis.fewer_books: no price: the row is unpriced on this basis (no fallback to one book, nothing invented)
basis.own_prices: own captures and the football-data single-book pairs (Bet365 / Pinnacle) do NOT price O/U 2.5 on this basis (they are one book each); history before 2023-05-03 has no per-book bet-time quotes, so those rows are unpriced on this basis
basis.close: CLV only: median of each book's LATEST pre-kickoff close-role (B1) pair, >= 3 books; never a bet price
basis.note_vs_pr104: PR #104 (serving draft) builds the reference as the median of per-book DE-VIGGED fair probabilities. This addendum follows the owner's words as relayed (median of the REAL, vigged prices per side). The two differ; reported, not resolved here.

coverage_check_first: before any fit: per track x league x window, O/U 2.5 rows with >= 1 and >= 3 books at bet time (output/research/p11_bars_tiers_v3/median_coverage.json). If the store cannot build the median for enough history the basis is reported as a gap and only the fixed-order D1 re-measure runs.
method: unchanged: the v3 bars method (src.bars_opt.study select on fit < 2026-09-01, final once on validation 2026-09-01..11-08, per-league own bars, no global bars, strict PROVEN rule), run on the median-basis priced universes; serving cells + proposal in namespace bars_p11v3med
outputs: a separate PROPOSAL (namespace bars_p11v3med) + a side-by-side of the O/U 2.5 cells, median basis vs fixed-order basis, in reports/P11V3_PRICE_GAPS_REMEASURE.md
validation_label: the validation window's outcomes were seen before (P9, P11 v1, v2, v3 run 1): re-validation numbers, never proof
